design-system-introduction--docs.title: Design system/Introduction
design-system-introduction--docs.content:
import { Meta, Markdown } from '@storybook/addon-docs/blocks'
import { markdownPages } from '../markdown-pages'

export const rulesIntro = markdownPages('design-system').intro

<Meta title="Design system/Introduction" />

# Coach Poulpy design system

<Markdown>{rulesIntro}</Markdown>

The landing site, the web app and these pages draw with one package, [`web/ui`](https://github.com/tkint/coach-poulpy/tree/main/web/ui): DaisyUI with the Poulpy theme and a few Vue components on top ([ADR 0023](https://tkint.github.io/coach-poulpy/docs/adr/0023-the-websites-share-one-vue-and-daisyui-design-system)). This workshop is its home ([ADR 0028](https://tkint.github.io/coach-poulpy/docs/adr/0028-storybook-is-the-component-workshop-of-the-design-system), [ADR 0029](https://tkint.github.io/coach-poulpy/docs/adr/0029-mockups-are-stories-in-the-component-workshop)).

- **Rules**: how to use [colour](?path=/docs/design-system-rules-colour--docs), [type](?path=/docs/design-system-rules-type--docs), [space, radius and motion](?path=/docs/design-system-rules-space-radius-and-motion--docs), [icons](?path=/docs/design-system-rules-icons--docs), [accessibility](?path=/docs/design-system-rules-accessibility--docs), the [components](?path=/docs/design-system-rules-components--docs), the [screens](?path=/docs/design-system-rules-screens--docs) and the [websites](?path=/docs/design-system-rules-websites--docs). They are written in [`docs/design-system.md`](https://github.com/tkint/coach-poulpy/blob/main/docs/design-system.md), which agents read; these pages show it.
- [Tokens](?path=/docs/design-system-tokens--docs): every value, read from `design/tokens.json`.
- **Core**: what is the same on every platform: Poulpy and the body map. They are drawn here with the web components.
- **Web > Components**: each Vue component in every state, with its classes. Each state is a story and runs as a test in CI, with an accessibility check. Use the toolbar to switch between light and dark.
- **Mobile > Components**: the raw pieces of the Android and iOS screens (buttons, chips, fields, rows), one page each, with a story per variation and controls to try them.
- **Mobile > Patterns**: pieces composed from those, such as the nav bar, sheets and charts.
- **Mobile > Screens**: every agreed phone screen, built from the components and patterns, and the drafts ([ADR 0029](https://tkint.github.io/coach-poulpy/docs/adr/0029-mockups-are-stories-in-the-component-workshop)).

## Classes

Every DaisyUI class carries the `cp-` prefix (`cp-btn`, not `btn`); the few classes of our own (`cp-chip`, `cp-stepper`, `cp-type-*`...) never reuse a DaisyUI name. Tailwind's own utilities (`w-full`, `bg-secondary`) have no prefix. A component's docs page lists the classes it renders.

Type has plain classes and no component: `cp-type-display`, `cp-type-title`, `cp-type-headline`, `cp-type-label`.

brand-introduction--docs.title: Brand/Introduction
brand-introduction--docs.content:
import { Meta, Markdown } from '@storybook/addon-docs/blocks'
import { markdownPages } from '../markdown-pages'

export const intro = markdownPages('brand').intro

<Meta title="Brand/Introduction" />

# Poulpy and the brand

<Markdown>{intro}</Markdown>

- [Character](?path=/docs/brand-character--docs): what Poulpy is and never does, and his tentacles.
- [Moods](?path=/docs/brand-moods--docs): his two sides, six moods, which drawing shows when, and the ember side.
- [Inclusive by default](?path=/docs/brand-inclusive-by-default--docs) and [Voice, logo and type](?path=/docs/brand-voice-logo-and-type--docs).
- [Drawings](?path=/docs/brand-drawings--docs): every portrait, pose and the loader, as generated.
- [Poulpy in 3D](?path=/docs/brand-poulpy-in-3d--docs): the model to turn around, its rules and how to reuse it.
- [Poulpy's moves](?path=/docs/brand-poulpy-s-moves-turning--docs): how he turns, jumps and cheers in 3D, one move a page.
- [Brand book](?path=/docs/brand-brand-book--docs): logo, colours, poses, type and behaviour, with every drawing live.
- [Decisions](?path=/docs/brand-decisions--docs): what was decided and why. [Ideas for later](?path=/docs/brand-ideas-for-later--docs).

These pages show [`docs/brand.md`](https://github.com/tkint/coach-poulpy/blob/main/docs/brand.md) and [`docs/brand-decisions.md`](https://github.com/tkint/coach-poulpy/blob/main/docs/brand-decisions.md), which agents read; edit the rules there.

import { Meta, Canvas } from '@storybook/addon-docs/blocks'
import * as Poulpy from '../PoulpyReference.stories'

<Meta title="Brand/Drawings" />

# Drawings

Poulpy's six mood portraits, his poses and the loader, as generated by [`design/build-poulpy.mjs`](https://github.com/tkint/coach-poulpy/blob/main/design/build-poulpy.mjs). Portraits and poses share one 248 × 226 frame, so they can replace each other without moving. When each one shows is on the [Moods](?path=/docs/brand-moods--docs#when-each-drawing-shows) page. The same drawings, as the apps use them, are under [Core > Poulpy](?path=/docs/core-poulpy--docs).
